spans.s:
ज 1. ज, the third letter of the second or
palatal class of consonants, having the sound of ज् in
जुम्प्.
—ज-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ज.

ज 2. ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन्, and used
at the end of comp.), born from, descended from, a
son or daughter of, produced or caused by, born in,
produced in or at or upon, growing in, living at,
being at [cf. अत्रि-दृग्-ज, धृतराष्ट्र-ज, आत्म-
ज, अण्ड-ज, कुल-ज, वन-ज, सरसि-ज, अग्र-ज,
अवर-ज, एक-ज, &c.]; prepared from, made of or
with; belonging to, connected with, peculiar to [cf.
अन्न-ज and शक्र-ज]; (अस्), m. a father, pro-
genitor; birth, production; [cf. जा.]

ज 3. ज, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with the
preceding by some lexicographers, but the meanings
appear to be artificial), speedy, swift; victorious,
triumphant, conquering; eaten; (अस्), m. speed;
enjoyment; light, lustre; poison; a Piśāca; a N.
of Viṣṇu; also of Śiva; (आ), f. a husband's brother's
wife.

जा जा, आस्, आस्, अम् (fr. rt. जन्, and used in
Ved. for 2. ज, which appears rarely in the Veda),
born, produced, &c. [cf. अग्नि-जा, अग्र-जा, अद्रि-जा,
इन्द्र-जा, गो-जा, &c.], see 2. ज; (आस्), m. f., Ved.
offspring, descendants; (आ), f. a race, tribe.
—जास्-
पति, इस्, m. (जास् gen. fr. जा ?), the father or head of
a family or house.
—जास्पत्य, अम्, n., Ved. the state
or condition of the father of a family.
